title: HELIX Govern: Data Sharing Agreement Template
description: Template for data sharing agreements between institutions, vendors, researchers, or agencies. Pre-populated with FERPA and GLBA requirements. Legal counsel should review and customize.

sections.template: This Agreement governs the sharing of [HELIX resources] between [Institution] (Provider) and [Receiving Party] (Recipient) for the purpose of [specific purpose].

ferpa_exceptions: School official with legitimate educational interest (34 CFR 99.31(a)(1))

sections.template: Recipient may use data solely for [stated purpose]. No re-sharing, marketing, or automated decision-making about individuals without human review.

requirements: Encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+)
No personal devices or unauthorized cloud storage
GLBA Safeguards Rule compliance if applicable

sections.template: Retain only for [period]. Destroy all copies within [30/60/90] days of completion. Provide certificate of destruction.
Notify within [24/48/72] hours. Include: nature, elements affected, record count, remediation steps.
Provider may audit Recipient's compliance with [30] days written notice.
Per 34 CFR 99.32, Provider will maintain a record of this disclosure.
Either party may terminate with [30] days notice. Security and destruction obligations survive.
